summary: INV-08 Leave a project: implemented POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/leave enabling any active project member (Manager, Member, Viewer) to leave their project grant with idempotency replay support. Workspace Owners are prevented from leaving their project/workspace (403 FORBIDDEN - must transfer workspace ownership instead), and outsiders receive 404 NOT_FOUND. Transition updates project_memberships.status to 'removed' and increments version, immediately revoking project access while fully preserving historical card assignees, comments, and activity audit trails. All automated integration tests pass against local PostgreSQL.
limitations: Ownership transfer flow is scoped to ACC-05 / S6.
